profile.headline: Software Engineer at Assembly Legal
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Kara James! I am currently employed as a Software Engineer at Assembly Legal.

positions.title: Software Engineer II + Scrum Master
positions.description:
Software Engineer II
- Mentoring fellow developers both through reviewing merge requests and paired programming
- Leading design efforts for new microservices and expanding existing microservices

Scrum Master
- Continuously guiding my team’s efforts to improve their processes and predictability
- Coordinating and communicating updates with other teams and management

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Working closely with teammates to build and maintain greenfield enterprise software for the insurance technology industry
- Developing in a full stack test driven development environment

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
As of July 2016, my responsibilities have also included acting as Project Manager for the website, which has included leading weekly team meetings, grooming a project backlog, and coordinating large-scale projects:
- Advocate for User Experience testing; oversee data collection and provide preliminary analysis for the Marketing team
- Manage a website redesign to increase clarity and usability of the website, including organizing three teams of marketers, developers, and designers across two companies
- Training the Marketing department in utilizing project management software to increase productivity
- Set up a knowledge repository and style guide for the Viaero codebase

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Consistently maintain and improve Viaero's website using C#, SQL, JavaScript, CSS and HTML skills:
- Drastically reduced the incidence of fraud cases by removing automated credit card processing from checkout
- Implemented a Save Cart feature which increased sales by 2%
- Automated the application of six promotions and two discounts in the checkout process, increasing page views by 30% and sessions by 37%
- Integrated HubSpot, SnapEngage and Google Analytics with the website

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed a game for teaching coding basics in Python named Codeventures. Led a team of four people in the planning and development of the application.

positions.title: Learning Assistant for the Computer Science Educational Labs
positions.description: Installed and fixed virtual machines for Computer Science students, answered a wide range of programming questions for students, and assisted students in becoming connected with the resources the Computer Science department offered

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held office hours, graded exams and papers, and held review sessions for Dr. Paul J. Pacheco.

positions.title: Assistant Supervisor for Archaeological Field School
positions.description: Supervised the field technicians' work and note taking, kept detailed site entries, kept notes and artifacts organized for Dr. Paul J. Pacheco.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held office hours, wrote test questions, graded exams, and held review sessions for Dr. Zhiming Zhao.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in Physical Anthropology and Linguistics.

positions.title: Outreach Worker
positions.description: Conversed with people to raise environmental awareness.

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped re-design and implement the Code for Boulder website. Previously, I also helped with the Trends Online project; our goal is to take the county-wide data presented in Trends, and make it accessible online through a website.
Managed seven officers, organized twice-weekly meetings and monthly events

organizations.name: Science Fiction and Fantasy Underground
organizations.description: I revived the club, and grew the amount of active members from two to twenty within the space of a semester. Afterwards, I drafted the constitution, and organized elections for a board of officers. I was elected President, and spent the next year and a half managing seven officers, organizing meetings and events, and leading recruitment efforts.

organizations.name: Geneseo Area Gaming Group
organizations.description: I assisted in the coordination of five to six events per semester. I scribed meeting minutes and crafted meeting agendas for each weekly meeting, and managed timetables for the ten person Executive Board.
